$comment: Brand-and-claim rules for the Luvita Enerji site (luvita-docs#9, EmirErs W7). Run after `npm run build`: python3 .github/scripts/brand-check.py. Schema: https://github.com/AnunnakiCosmoCrew/project-templates/tree/main/actions/brand-claim-check

rules.why: CLAUDE.md, Keep the two vitrines separate / luvita-docs ADR 0001 exception: this site may say it is a Luvita Teknoloji company but must NOT link to luvita.tr (rule inventory 55).
luvita-docs ADR 0001 (Luvi Enerji exception) / adr/0002: the footer names the entity in text form, unlinked, so a reviewer verifying the company can identify it.
CLAUDE.md: never publish the registered street address; site.address stays city-level (Bodrum, Muğla). No streetAddress in JSON-LD either (rule inventory 54/118).

CLAUDE.md: no map embeds and no third parties beyond the quote form's two: no <iframe> of any provider is allowed in the built HTML (Turnstile renders its own at runtime from its script) (rule inventory 118).
CLAUDE.md: no dealership claims; there is no written authorisation from any manufacturer (rule inventory 65).
CLAUDE.md: CW Enerji was removed from the site entirely (2026-08-22, owner's decision); only TommaTech is named, and only as equipment used (rule inventory 65).

CLAUDE.md: no prices on the site; supply costs are USD-based, packages are described by capacity and components, price comes via quote (rule inventory 65). Matches a currency amount next to a price word (fiyat, price, KDV, VAT, per kWp...). The gap between amount and keyword may contain HTML tags (10.000 ₺ KDV dahil).

CLAUDE.md: no prices on the site. Any other currency amount is reported for a human to confirm it is a customer's bill bracket, not a price. The quote form's bill brackets and the audience line are allow-listed.

rules.why: CLAUDE.md / adr/0003 brand voice: never promise "%100 bağımsızlık" or "bedava elektrik" (rule inventory 65).
CLAUDE.md, Minimal external requests: the only third parties are the form endpoint (Web3Forms) and optional Cloudflare Turnstile, both loaded only on the quote page.

CLAUDE.md, Minimal external requests: on the quote page the only third parties are the Web3Forms endpoint (form action https://api.web3forms.com/submit) and Cloudflare Turnstile (script https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/); any other external script, form target or resource is rejected.
CLAUDE.md: no analytics SDKs, no web fonts, no CDN embeds.
LUVITA.md, Brands: public names only; "Luvi Energy" was the earlier working brand, the public brand is Luvita Enerji (rule inventory 58).
